Most memory systems are black boxes. You can't tell if your agent's memories were modified between sessions -- by a bug, a misconfiguration, or a targeted attack.

cathedral-witness is a lightweight notary layer that works on top of Anthropic native memory, OpenAI memory, or any custom store. Cathedral never sees your memory contents, only hashes.

The flow:
1. Hash your memory state at a known-good point
2. Register the hash with Cathedral (gets a witness receipt)
3. Later: re-hash and verify -- intact or modified verdict
